title: Card 1: kuch thread (event loop) lakhon connection sambhalte. Connection khula rehta, thread tabhi jab data aaye

1 lakh log ek saath dobara judte: ruk-ruk ke, random waqt pe (backoff + jitter). Message nahi khota
